invariants.rationale: metaClient is used unconditionally in the method, so it is likely never null at method exit.
inFlightInstantTimestamp is passed as an argument and potentially accessed, so it is likely non-null.
metaClient.reloadTableConfig() might be called, which generally expects getTableConfig() to be non-null.
As Option, isPresent() is always defined and will return either true or false, capturing exhaustiveness.
